adoption: none; no predictive or economic validation
clock: source received_time int64 nanoseconds; source-specific, no synthetic latency correction
window_boundary: (t-L,t], exact retention boundary retained; no cross-gap or snapshot window carry
input_contract: atomically grouped depth messages with U/u/pu; valid consecutive trade IDs; placeholder excluded without skipping ID
denominator_rule: nonpositive/missing denominator => NaN; valid no-event rates after complete warmup => 0
group_order: source nanosecond receipt order; if timestamps tie, replay uses depth before trade, documented observational ordering
geometry: near range uses abs(price_index - pre-message best_index)<=2; no duplicate level keys per atomic update
complexity: heap book updates O(log levels), bounded 60s event deques; query O(retained events), no claim of O(1)
stale_policy: S01-S05/S16-S21 unavailable if depth receipt age>3s; S23 unavailable if book receipt age>3s; S14/S15/S25-S27 unavailable if completed bucket age>60s; absent quota => NaN; S27 additionally requires a full bucket_count closed-bucket window

factors.name: depth_message_rate_1s
factors.formula: 完整增量消息数/1s
factors.overlap_note: A7数价位行，本项数完整消息

factors.name: near_bid_net_add_rate_1s
factors.formula: Σp max(Δq,0)，买侧、距消息前最优价≤2ticks
factors.overlap_note: 补近端净增加

factors.name: near_ask_net_add_rate_1s
factors.formula: 同S02，卖侧
factors.overlap_note: 补近端净增加

factors.name: near_bid_net_decrease_rate_1s
factors.formula: Σp max(-Δq,0)，买侧、距消息前最优价≤2ticks
factors.overlap_note: B1为30s全簿，本项近端1s

factors.name: near_ask_net_decrease_rate_1s
factors.formula: 同S04，卖侧
factors.overlap_note: B2为30s全簿，本项近端1s

factors.name: buy_notional_rate_1s
factors.formula: Σ主动买成交名义额/1s
factors.overlap_note: 已有buy_qty与流比例，本项绝对名义额流速

factors.name: sell_notional_rate_1s
factors.formula: Σ主动卖成交名义额/1s
factors.overlap_note: 同S06

factors.name: notional_acceleration_0p5s_5s
factors.overlap_note: C8是流向不平衡变化，本项总流量加速度

factors.name: last_valid_trade_age_ms
factors.formula: 决策时间减最近有效成交接收时间
factors.overlap_note: 成交稀疏/空窗状态

factors.name: trade_interval_cv_5s
factors.formula: 5s内有效成交接收间隔总体标准差/均值
factors.overlap_note: 至少3笔且均值>0

factors.name: trailing_quota_duration_all_ms
factors.formula: 向后累计成交额首次达到Q，决策时间减边界成交接收时间
factors.overlap_note: 完整大单边界，不插值

factors.name: trailing_quota_duration_buy_ms
factors.formula: 同S11，仅主动买
factors.overlap_note: 方向量时钟

factors.name: trailing_quota_duration_sell_ms
factors.formula: 同S11，仅主动卖
factors.overlap_note: 方向量时钟

factors.name: equal_notional_bucket_abs_imbalance
factors.formula: 最近20个完成的Q桶平均|buy-sell|/Q
factors.overlap_note: C9是时间桶代理；本项完成等额桶

factors.name: last_completed_volume_bucket_duration_ms
factors.formula: 最后完成Q桶的末笔时间减上一桶结束时间；首桶从首筆时间开始
factors.overlap_note: 同毫秒多桶可为0，不求倒数

factors.name: near_depth_depletion_asymmetry_1s
factors.formula: S04/当前近端买深度名义额-S05/当前近端卖深度名义额
factors.overlap_note: 方向化流动性净下降压力，非真实撤单毒性概率

factors.name: near_depth_imbalance
factors.formula: (近端买深度名义额-近端卖深度名义额)/(两者和)
factors.overlap_note: 近端深度静态失衡，与S16的流量归一口径互补

factors.name: touch_qty_imbalance
factors.formula: (最优买档名义额-最优卖档名义额)/(两者和)
factors.overlap_note: L1静态失衡；对照组l1_imbalance为评测控制变量

factors.name: bid_replenish_share
factors.formula: S02/(S02+S04) 买侧近端补充/(补充+消耗)
factors.overlap_note: 净L2代理补充率，非真实挂单识别；queue-reactive风格

factors.name: ask_replenish_share
factors.formula: S03/(S03+S05) 卖侧近端补充/(补充+消耗)
factors.overlap_note: 净L2代理补充率，非真实挂单识别；queue-reactive风格

factors.name: near_net_flow_share
factors.overlap_note: 流量自身归一，与S16深度归一互补；净L2代理

factors.name: taker_imbalance_1s
factors.formula: (S06-S07)/(S06+S07) 主动买卖金额失衡
factors.overlap_note: 不依赖簿新鲜度；对照组taker_ratio_1s为评测控制变量

factors.name: taker_vwap_basis_bp_5s
factors.formula: ((买主动VWAP-卖主动VWAP)/mid)*1e4，mid取簿内最优
factors.overlap_note: 需簿新鲜；买卖两侧5s成交量和均需为正

factors.name: trade_value_concentration_5s
factors.formula: 5s内最大单笔成交额/5s总成交额
factors.overlap_note: 突发大单集中度；无成交为NaN

factors.name: bucket_imbalance_streak
factors.formula: 最近连续同号带符号桶失衡计数（0号桶打断）
factors.overlap_note: 依赖带符号桶失衡；量钟趋势持续性

factors.name: bucket_duration_cv
factors.formula: 保留窗口内闭合桶时长CV(pstdev/mean，同S10算法)
factors.overlap_note: 量钟节拍不规则度；桶数<2为NaN

factors.name: bucket_imbalance_momentum
factors.formula: 最近半数带符号桶失衡均值-前一半均值
factors.overlap_note: 需满bucket_count窗口否则NaN；与S14同样本窗口

parameter_policy: Q=max(1USDC,median of 60 complete-minute notional totals / 5), fitted strictly earlier; refit inside training folds before predictive evaluation

validation.scope: calculation, causality and real-feed sample only
validation.v1.1.0_bounded_replay: Historical sample artifacts retired during cleanup; rerun the flow validation for current dataset evidence. Unit/causality tests remain in tools/tests/test_flow_factor_library.py.
